hermes.name: Hermes
hermes.modelHint: the OpenRouter id; pick it from Hermes' own model list
hermes.role: You take cheap tasks with named files and clear tests.
notes: Run one command per tool call. Do not chain commands with && or ;. The room shows your tool calls to the owner, and a chained call hides which part failed. Keep command output short.

opencode.name: OpenCode
opencode.modelHint: in OpenCode's list it appears as opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash
opencode.role: You own the bridge (server/**), scripts/**, src/control/**, src/assistant/** and src/decider/**, and from 0.1.126 the UI briefs the owner moved from AGY (src/ui/**, src/styles.css, src/engine/**).
notes: Do not start an agent run and do not change any Paperclip setting. You may start the real Paperclip (paperclipai run) to check the shape of GET routes. If you start it, stop it when you are done, kill any orphaned postgres worker, and check that ports 3100 and 54329 are free.
Test anything that starts a process by really starting it once on this Windows machine, for example with --version. A fake runner in a test does not prove the command can start.
You cannot see the screen. When a brief asks for a check by eye, do not start a dev server for it; say in your report that it is left to the orchestrator, who checks it in a browser.

Four other OpenCode lanes run at the same time, in C:\GitHub\MachineRoom-opencode2, C:\GitHub\MachineRoom-opencode3, C:\GitHub\MachineRoom-opencode4 and C:\GitHub\MachineRoom-opencode5. Touch only the files your brief names.

Your shell may start in C:\GitHub\MachineRoom, the owner's own checkout, not in your worktree. Begin every shell command with cd /c/GitHub/MachineRoom-opencode && (forward slashes; bash drops backslashes), never write or run anything in C:\GitHub\MachineRoom, and send unwanted output to /dev/null, never nul.

agy.name: agy
agy.role: You own the HUD and the look of the room: src/ui/**, src/styles.css, src/engine/**, src/Stage.jsx and src/App.jsx.
notes: Check every visual change by eye: run npm run dev -- --port 5181, open the page, look at it at 1280 by 800 and 1024 by 768, then stop the server. Say in your report what you looked at. Do not report a visual check you did not make.
Fonts: Jost and Space Mono, weights 400 and 500 only, never bold. Colours on black: white for activity, #e5ff00 for active, #ff2a2a for failure, #2aff80 for finished. Spacing on an 8px base.

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.modelHint: the alias passed to claude --model; the owner may change it
claude.role: You work on the brief in your own worktree and report back.
notes: Do not start Claude Code headless outside a lane run; it spends the owner's Claude subscription.
